vulnerability_title: [M-09] `checkpoint()` does not correct `effectiveBond` downward at year boundaries where inflation decreases

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: checkpoint adds the next epoch's maxBond to effectiveBond in advance (lines 1279-1280) and later corrects effectiveBond only when the actual maxBond is larger than the predicted one, with no branch for the smaller case. This is the one-way correction the finding describes.
patterns_found: next epoch maxBond credited to effectiveBond in advance
issues: Lines 1248-1267 already mix the old and new inflation rates when the next epoch is predicted to cross a year boundary. The finding does not discuss this, so the size of the over-credit could not be confirmed from the code.
The second problem_code block (lines 67-179) comes from the TokenomicsConstants.sol link and shows unrelated error declarations.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: bond credit not reduced when actual inflation is lower than predicted
